fact: The drive failed to follow Race Directors instructions after running off at Turn 11.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code – Non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 16.3, document 8).
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, telemetry and incar video evidence. Car 55 went off at Turn 11 and the driver did not comply with the Race Director's Event Note which required him to drive to the left of the second polystyrene block.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Failed To Follow Race Directors Instructions Turn 11
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
